# fct_booking_draft_changes

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_booking_draft_changes` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Booking draft and operational data for self-logged bookings. Includes T/F booleans to indicate if a field's value matches the the value approved by HQ

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | User ID for the Advisor >> Source - Portal DB |
| `assigned_at` | When the self-logged Booking was assigned to a member of the offshore team >> Source - Portal DB |
| `assigned_to_email` | Contact information of the offshore member that a self-logged booking draft was assigned to >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booked_date` | When the Booking was self-logged by the Advisor >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_draft_created_at` | When the initial Booking draft record was created. When AI parses >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_channel_id` | Foreign Key to the Booking Channel in Portal >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_created_at` | When the initial Booking record was created. This is when an advisor submits a self-logged booking and a booking is created >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_draft_change_id` | Primary key of the booking_draft_changes table, made up of the draft_id and the created_at timestamp data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `booking_draft_id` | Foreign Key. The id of a Booking draft created during the self-logging process >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_draft_status` | The status of a self-logged booking draft during the verification/QA process >> Source - Portal DB |
| `previous_booking_draft_status` | The booking_draft_status of the immediately preceding record for this booking draft, ordered by changed_at. Useful for tracking transitions e.g. UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED or UNDER_REVIEW → REJECTED >> Source - Portal DB |
| `next_booking_draft_status` | The booking_draft_status of the immediately following record for this booking draft, ordered by changed_at. Useful for tracking transitions e.g. UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED or UNDER_REVIEW → REJECTED >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_id` | Foreign Key. Identifier for each Booking record. In the self-logging process this is assigned once the advisor has submitted their self-logging booking for review >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_local_currency` | Local currency of the self-logged booking >> Source - Portal DB record matches the booking_local_currency approved by HQ >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_status` | The status of a self-logged booking during the verification/QA process >> Source - Portal DB |
| `booking_uuid` | UUID version of the Booking_ID >> Source - Portal DB |
| `changed_at` | When the record of the self-logged Draft or Booking was made. Use this when looking for the date of a self-logged record >> Source - Portal DB |
| `change_source` | source table of the change, if both the 'Booking_historicalbookingdraft and 'Booking_historicalbooking' tables are listed then a change occured in both tables (i.e. both booking data and operational data was changed) |

| `end_date` | When the 'End' of a self-logged Booking is, such as the departure date from a hotel >> Source - Portal DB |
